'''Christopher John Hawkesworth''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Edinburgh|FRSE]] (born 18 December 1947) is a British earth scientist, and former Deputy Principal and Vice-Principal for Research, at [[University of St Andrews]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/administration/principalsoffice/deputyprincipal/ |title=Deputy Principal and Master of the United College &#124; University of St Andrews |access-date=2011-12-26 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090925185156/http://www.st-andrews.ac.uk/administration/principalsoffice/deputyprincipal/ |archive-date=25 September 2009 |df=dmy-all }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/article/oupww/whoswho/U43488 |title=HAWKESWORTH, Prof. Christopher John |website=Who's Who 2015 |publisher=A & C Black; [[Oxford University Press]] |orig-date=2014 |date=2015}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Hawkesworth was born in [[Khartoum]], Sudan on 18 December 1947, and was brought up in Ireland. He graduated with from [[Trinity College, Dublin]] in 1970, and then moved to [[Oxford University]] where he studied for a DPhil in geology at [[St Edmund Hall, Oxford|St Edmund Hall]] from 1970 to 1974, under the supervision of Professor [[Ronald Oxburgh, Baron Oxburgh|Ron Oxburgh]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.seh.ox.ac.uk/people/chris-hawkesworth|title=Professor Chris Hawkesworth Honorary Fellow|work=St Edmund Hall}}</ref> While at Oxford, Hawkesworth played rugby for the University, and was awarded [[Blue (university sport)|Blues]] in 1970, 1971 and 1972 after playing in the annual [[The Varsity Match|Oxford - Cambridge rugby union varsity matches]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ourfc.org/blues-numbers|title=OURFC Men's Blues Numbers}}</ref>

He held positions at [[Open University]] and [[University of Bristol]] prior to holding the Wardlaw Chair of Earth Sciences and the position of Deputy Principal and Vice-Principal of Research at the [[University of St Andrews]] until 2014.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.seh.ox.ac.uk/people/chris-hawkesworth |title=Professor Chris Hawkesworth, Honorary Fellow |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=St Edmund Hall |publisher=[[Oxford University]] |access-date=2020-12-21 |quote=}}</ref> 

He was awarded the [[Wollaston Medal]] in 2012. In 2012, he was elected a Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.rse.org.uk/fellow/christopher-hawkesworth/ |title=Professor Christopher John Hawkesworth FRSE - The Royal Society of Edinburgh |work=The [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]] |access-date=2018-06-26 |language=en-GB}}</ref> In 2020, he was made a member of the [[Royal Irish Academy]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ria.ie/news/membership/29-new-members-admitted |title=29 New Members Admitted |work=[[Royal Irish Academy]] |date=22 May 2020 |access-date=27 Nov 2021}}</ref>
